title: Three refused consents for new dwellings and resource-consent prerequisite (Tuakau)
jurisdiction: New Zealand (MBIE, Building Act 2004): comparative test only; not an Alberta case; no Alberta applicability asserted
document_type: MBIE determination under Building Act 2004 s188 (regulator decision on an individual matter); not an applicant's alternative-solution file

facts.text: Three building consent applications (BLD 0290/21, BLD 0295/21, BLD 0297/21) for new dwellings at three addresses in Tuakau; owner is a trustee company.
Appendix A1 quotes s37 (territorial authority must issue a certificate where a resource consent is required) and related provisions.
Decision: authority incorrect in its purported refusal of the three consents; decision reversed and a new decision required (16 December 2021).
